BrochureContent.Content:
Coming to the market in turnkey condition, is this two-bedroom terraced property, located in the ever-popular development of Brindley Park on the outskirts of Ashbourne Town Centre. 

Upon entering the property, you arrive in the bright hallway, which leads off to the sitting room. The light-filled sitting room is located to the front of the property and boasts a fireplace with electric insert. Double doors lead to the kitchen / dining room, which has patio doors leading to an enclosed rear garden.

The first floor consists of two double bedrooms, both of which benefit from fitted. A master ensuite bathroom and main bathroom completes the property accommodation. There is off street parking to the front.

Brindley Park is a much sought-after development and it is located within walking distance to Ashbourne Town Centre. Ashbourne has a wide variety of excellent housing choices to suit your lifestyle preferences. Whether you prefer the buzz of the town life or the quiet calm of a rural setting, Ashbourne has plenty of options for you. From large detached family homes to semi-detached houses to bungalows or apartments.

The town now boasts six Primary Schools, to include St. Declan's National School, St. Mary's National School, Ashbourne Educate Together National School, Gaelscoil Na Colle, Gaelscoil Na Mí and Ashbourne Community National School. There are also two Secondary Schools; Ashbourne Community School and Colaiste De Lacy.

There is an excellent bus service serving Dublin city and surrounding areas.

To arrange a viewing contact DNG Tormey Lee on 01 835 7089.
